role: Declared deterministic certification limits. A numeric limit is not a claim that every assembled device has been qualified to it.

marine_motion.qualification: retained outward marine envelope; same-history all-time primitive membership must still be certified

qualification.B_a: derived from the retained commissioned per-axis 0.13 m/s^2 residual envelope
qualification.D_a: selected deterministic deployment limit; assembled-history qualification is open

magnetic_service.qualification: selected certification limits; source-uniform accepted informative service is open

sensor_model.qualification: deterministic commissioned BMI270 profile; deployment qualification remains separate
